atomic_facts.fact: Iñaki Urdangarin Liebaert is a retired Spanish handball player.
Iñaki Urdangarin Liebaert is the former husband of Infanta Cristina.
The Nóos Institute is a nonprofit foundation.
Urdangarin was a leader of the Nóos Institute.
Urdangarin was involved in the Nóos case, accused of using Nóos to embezzle about 6 million euros in public funds.
The Wikipedia article on the Nóos affair states that on 17 February 2017 Urdangarin was given a six-year-and-three-month prison sentence for his role in the case.
A Spanish court convicted Urdangarin on 17 February 2017 (entailed by the imposition of a prison sentence in the Spanish Nóos case).
The sentence was six years and three months in prison.
The cited excerpt from the Iñaki Urdangarin Wikipedia article states that in June 2018 he was sentenced to 5 years and 10 months in prison.
The cited excerpt from the Iñaki Urdangarin Wikipedia article states that the sentence was reduced on appeal by the Supreme Court on 12 June 2018.
